The '''Phorose system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorose]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Phorosian]]s and the [[Ru]].<ref name="Paradise Lost" />
